title: SX1276 Multi-Node TDMA HIL Manifest (LAB-SCOPE V2)
description: Verifiable trial run record and raw evidence manifest for multi-node TDMA HIL testing and calculated timing under Issue #169 LAB-SCOPE V2.
provenance_requirement: Strict separation between CALCULATED_TOA, HOST_SYNTHETIC, SOFTWARE_TIMESTAMP, HARDWARE_DIGITAL_CAPTURE, ASSUMED_BOUND, RF_MEASURED, and NOT_VERIFIED.

hardware_environment.pa_path_verified: UNVERIFIED (Requires physical board trace check: RFO_HF vs PA_BOOST)
hardware_environment.rf_environment: Direct SMA Coaxial with 50-ohm Attenuator / Load (Conducted)

logic_analyzer.model: USB Logic Analyzer 24 MHz / 8CH (Cypress FX2 compatible)
logic_analyzer.sampling_limitations: 24 MS/s nominal cannot decode 10 MHz SPI clock; SPI debug configured at <= 4 MHz; standard operation samples NSS envelope, DIO0, and GPIO debug strobes

multimeter.measurements: DC Supply Voltage (3.30V), Continuity, Static DC Current

power_supply.safety_rule: Connected to board regulator input; never connect unregulated supply directly to 3V3 rail

measured_scenarios.description: TX command dispatch to DIO0 rising edge (TxDone)
DIO0 rising edge (RxDone) to FreeRTOS task unblock and buffer handoff
Gateway durable acceptance (NVS / queue commit) before sending Event ACK
SX1276 mode transition between RX and TX (digital envelope & FreeRTOS scheduling)
SPI transfer duration for packet read/write and ISR latency
Node deep-sleep wakeup, SX1276 hardware reset pulse, register plan reload
Relative clock drift across boards on shared Logic Analyzer over 10s, 60s, and 300s holdover
Observed slot overlap across multi-node boundaries under actual traffic
Full maintenance superframe execution (80B Beacon TX -> Sync Latch -> 21B Health Reply)

raw_evidence_files.description: 24 MHz USB logic analyzer raw 8-channel capture (pending physical bench run)
Continuous UART JSONL log stream from Node and Gateway runners

validation_verdict.rationale: Preparation package is complete for LAB-SCOPE V2. Physical boards were not connected during this turn. Specialized RF equipment is deferred out-of-scope for lab. Awaiting physical bench execution by human operator.
validation_verdict.gate_classification: Gate G1 / G3 NOT_VERIFIED (LAB-Scope Verification only)
